removed_yaml.title: The Simplepush YAML configuration has been removed
removed_yaml.description:
Configuring Simplepush using YAML has been removed.

Your existing YAML configuration is not used by Home Assistant.

Remove the Simplepush YAML configuration from your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.

send_task.name: Send task
send_task.description: Sends a task to your Simplepush devices or a topic. Ask for a response to wait for the first answer.

config_entry_id.name: Simplepush entry
config_entry_id.description: The Simplepush entry to send with.

markdown.name: Markdown
markdown.description: Show the message formatted as Markdown.

topic.name: Topic
topic.description: Topic to send to. It must be added to the Simplepush entry. Leave empty to send to your own devices.

shared.name: Shared
shared.description: Send one task that everyone on the topic sees. The first answer settles it for all.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: How loudly the push interrupts, 1 (minimal) to 5 (critical). Default 3.

expires_in.name: Expires in
expires_in.description: Seconds until the task expires and can no longer be answered. Required to wait for an answer.

files.name: Files
files.description: Local files to upload and attach. Only files in allowed directories are sent.

inputs.name: Inputs
inputs.description: What the recipient answers, in order. Each entry has a type, an optional description and required (default true). The README lists the options of each type.
